title: Empowering Dreams: Reliance Foundation Scholarships - Transforming Lives through Education
text: Empowering Dreams: Reliance Foundation Scholarships - Transforming Lives through Education Reliance Foundation Scholarships Nurturing India’s youth and future leaders Reliance has been providing scholarships to meritorious students for over 29 years, inspired by its Founder-Chairman Shri Dhirubhai Ambani’s belief that the best way to ensure the nation’s progress is to invest in its youth. Reliance Foundation Scholarships aim to nurture and empower students, enabling them to pursue higher education. In pursuing a brighter tomorrow, Reliance Foundation recognises the transformative power of education and the pivotal role of scholarships in making this a reality for many young people. Over the years, these scholarships have touched the lives of over 33,000 deserving students in India, opening doors of opportunity and nurturing future leaders. The Dhirubhai Ambani Scholarship (DAS), established in 1996, awards scholarships to students from underprivileged backgrounds. It empowers outstanding students to pursue their dreams of higher education, regardless of financial constraints. With 12,776 students benefitting from DAS across India, the impact reaches far and wide, embracing diversity and inclusivity. In 2020-21, the Reliance Foundation Scholarships (RFS) took flight, aiming to support India's brightest youth in fields like Artificial Intelligence, Computer Sciences, Mathematics & Computing, and Electrical and/or Electronics Engineering. The rigorous selection process identifies 100 exceptional students annually, enabling them to soar and lead India's technological growth. In December 2022, on the occasion of the 90th birth anniversary of Shri Dhirubhai Ambani, Founder - Chairman of Reliance Industries Limited, Reliance Foundation announced that it will significantly strengthen its commitment to youth, awarding 50,000 scholarships over the next 10 years for students pursuing higher education in India. Since 2022-2023, Reliance Foundation has been supporting 5,100 students annually, including 5,000 meritorious undergraduate students from underprivileged sections of society studying any stream of their choice through the Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships, and 100 of India's brightest postgraduate students studying eligible subjects in new technologies through the Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships.     Our Chairperson

    Guiding our vision and initiatives is our esteemed Chairperson Smt. Nita Mukesh Ambani, whose leadership and vision inspire us to reach new heights. Her commitment to philanthropy and societal well-being sets the tone for Reliance Foundation's impactful contributions.

    Our Story

    Our journey is one of dedication, passion, and unwavering commitment. Founded with a vision to make a meaningful difference, Reliance Foundation's story is shaped by the collective efforts of a team dedicated to fostering positive change and creating lasting impact.

    Our Impact & Reach

    Driven by a commitment to measurable impact, Reliance Foundation's initiatives have touched the lives of millions across the country. Our extensive reach ensures that our efforts have a far-reaching and lasting effect on communities.

    Annual Report

    Explore our Annual Reports to gain insights into the progress, achievements, and challenges faced throughout the year. These reports provide a comprehensive overview of our initiatives and their impact on the ground.

    Awards

    Our dedication and impact have been acknowledged through various accolades and awards. These recognitions serve as a testament to our commitment to excellence and our continuous efforts to contribute positively to society.

    What We do

    Reliance Foundation engages in a wide spectrum of activities, from healthcare initiatives to educational programs, rural transformation projects, and disaster response. Our multifaceted approach is aimed at creating holistic and sustainable solutions.

    What We Do

    Reliance Foundation is currently focusing on Rural Transformation, Health, Education, Sports for Development, Disaster Management, Women Empowerment, Arts, Culture & Heritage, Environment & Animal Welfare and Urban Renewal.

    Rural Transformation

    Empowering some of the most marginalised communities across rural India with innovative and sustainable solutions since 2010.

    Education

    Education is at the heart of Reliance Foundation’s vision for India and central to the country’s social and economic progress.

    Health

    We believe that quality and affordable healthcare is crucial not only for communities but also for the economic and social well-being of India.

    Sports For Development

    At the heart of our sports initiatives, the goal is to cultivate lifelong learning, build character, and foster leadership skills among India's youth.

    Disaster Management

    Reliance Foundation’s Disaster Management programme supports vulnerable hotspots in building safer and disaster-resilient communities.

    Women Empowerment

    Empowered women mean a stronger and a better world and we are committed to empowering women to play a catalytic role in bringing change.

    Arts, Culture & Heritage

    Reliance Foundation is constantly reimagining ways to protect and promote Indian Arts, Culture & Heritage.

    Environment & Animal Welfare

    Creating a better world for all beings through Vantara — a landmark initiative for wildlife rescue, care and conservation, and community-linked sustainability across India

    Urban Renewal

    The Urban Renewal initiatives of Reliance Foundation strive to enrich and improve public spaces to improve the quality of life and infrastructure in cities.

    Experts Speak

    Our esteemed experts bring valuable insights to the forefront, addressing pressing issues with a depth of knowledge and perspectives. Their contributions aim to enhance understanding, offering profound insights into complex challenges and potential solutions.

    India and the SDGs

    Aligned with the nation's priorities, we channel our efforts towards addressing key developmental challenges in a diverse set of thematic areas like education, healthcare, rural development, sports, women empowerment, art and culture to name a few.

Reliance Foundation Scholarships

Nurturing India’s youth and future leaders

Reliance has been providing scholarships to meritorious students for over 29 years, inspired by its Founder-Chairman Shri Dhirubhai Ambani’s belief that the best way to ensure the nation’s progress is to invest in its youth. Reliance Foundation Scholarships aim to nurture and empower students, enabling them to pursue higher education.

In pursuing a brighter tomorrow, Reliance Foundation recognises the transformative power of education and the pivotal role of scholarships in making this a reality for many young people. Over the years, these scholarships have touched the lives of over 33,000 deserving students in India, opening doors of opportunity and nurturing future leaders.

The Dhirubhai Ambani Scholarship (DAS), established in 1996, awards scholarships to students from underprivileged backgrounds. It empowers outstanding students to pursue their dreams of higher education, regardless of financial constraints. With 12,776 students benefitting from DAS across India, the impact reaches far and wide, embracing diversity and inclusivity.

In 2020-21, the Reliance Foundation Scholarships (RFS) took flight, aiming to support India's brightest youth in fields like Artificial Intelligence, Computer Sciences, Mathematics & Computing, and Electrical and/or Electronics Engineering. The rigorous selection process identifies 100 exceptional students annually, enabling them to soar and lead India's technological growth.

In December 2022, on the occasion of the 90th birth anniversary of Shri Dhirubhai Ambani, Founder - Chairman of Reliance Industries Limited, Reliance Foundation announced that it will significantly strengthen its commitment to youth, awarding 50,000 scholarships over the next 10 years for students pursuing higher education in India.

Since 2022-2023, Reliance Foundation has been supporting 5,100 students annually, including 5,000 meritorious undergraduate students from underprivileged sections of society studying any stream of their choice through the Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships, and 100 of India's brightest postgraduate students studying eligible subjects in new technologies through the Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships.
